name: 0DTE Long Call Scalp
summary: Buy a near-ATM call on expiration day and hold it for minutes, not hours, harvesting an intraday momentum burst before theta eats it.

legs.strike_rule: Delta 0.40-0.55 (ATM to one strike OTM); on SPY use the strike nearest spot

max_profit: Unbounded intraday, but realistically 30-100% of debit on a clean momentum leg
max_loss: Debit paid x 100, and 0DTE ATM options go to zero routinely. Assume full loss on every stop.
breakevens: strike + debit; irrelevant in practice because this is exited on P&L, not held to expiry

greeks.gamma: extremely high - the dominant greek; delta can go 0.40 to 0.80 on a 0.3% move
greeks.theta: catastrophic - an ATM 0DTE option loses roughly 8-15% of its value per 15 minutes midday, accelerating into the close
greeks.vega: small in dollars but IV collapses through the day (vol crush into the close)

when_to_use: Only on SPY/QQQ/IWM, only 10:00-15:00 ET, only with a mechanical momentum trigger. Best on trend days; worst on chop days, where theta plus spread is a guaranteed bleed.
entry_rules: Underlying restricted to SPY, QQQ, IWM (penny-wide 0DTE chains). No single names
Time window 10:00-15:00 ET. No entries in the 09:30-10:00 opening auction noise, none after 15:00 ET
Momentum trigger required: 5-minute close above the opening range high AND VWAP, with the 5-min bar volume >= 1.5x the 20-bar average
Strike delta 0.40-0.55 computed locally (Alpaca returns no greeks or IV on 0DTE at any tier - use Black-Scholes with T in fractions of a trading day and a locally estimated IV)
Bid/ask <= $0.03 absolute; reject the trade otherwise
Debit <= 0.5% of equity per scalp (~$250 on $50k); max 3 scalps per day; stop trading for the day after 2 consecutive losses
Daily 0DTE loss limit: -1.5% of equity (~$750). Hitting it disables 0DTE for the session
management_rules: Take profit at +30% of debit. This is deliberately small - 0DTE edge decays in minutes
Hard time stop: 15 minutes in the position. Flat regardless of P&L
Trail after +30%: stop moves to +10% and follows in 10% steps
Never add to a losing 0DTE scalp, and never roll a 0DTE option
exit_rules: Sell to close at +30%, -35%, or 15 minutes elapsed, whichever comes first

Absolute hard flatten at 15:45 ET: no 0DTE long option may be held past 15:45 ET. Anything $0.01 ITM at 16:00 ET is auto-exercised into 100 shares overnight, which is the exact outcome this system must never produce
If the option is worthless (bid = 0) before 15:45, abandon it and log the full loss
assignment_risk: No assignment (long), but the auto-exercise hazard is at its most acute here: a 0DTE call that closes $0.01 ITM delivers 100 shares plus a large settlement obligation. The 15:45 ET flatten is non-negotiable.
liquidity_needs: Penny-wide only. SPY/QQQ 0DTE ATM strikes qualify; almost nothing else does.
common_mistakes: Holding for the big move and watching theta erase a winner; trading 0DTE on chop days; trading 0DTE single names with $0.20 spreads; letting a winner expire ITM instead of selling it.
zero_dte_notes: Research consensus: long 0DTE premium has negative expectancy across a large sample because the median SPY daily move is smaller than what buyers need. This strategy only survives with a strict momentum filter, a 15-minute time stop and a daily loss cap. Backtest it before trusting it.
